5.2Scope Map

What We Design, Build, and Commission

Five core technical domains covering machinery, material handling, tooling, and refurbishment.

C-01Domain

Induction Hardening Machines

Vertical, horizontal, dual-spindle, and rotary induction hardening systems with custom quench rings, scanning axes, and automatic part transfer.

  • Vertical scanning machinery (up to 1500mm length)
  • Horizontal tube hardening systems
  • Dual spindle high-throughput configurations
  • Rotary index table systems
  • Crankshaft & camshaft hardening
  • Automatic pneumatic & servo loading/unloading
C-02Domain

Conveying & Material Handling

Heavy-duty conveying systems engineered for hot forged billets, machined components, and automated transfer lines.

  • Forge-to-trim press heat-resistant chain conveyors
  • Honeycomb stainless steel belt conveyors
  • Wire mesh belt conveyors for quench tanks
  • Slat & modular belt conveyors for assembly
  • Automatic billet elevator loaders
  • Gravity roller & powered transfer decks
C-03Domain

Inspection & Automated Sorting

Inline non-destructive testing (NDT) integration with high-speed reject segregation mechanisms built directly into production lines.

  • Eddy current surface crack detection integration
  • Ultrasonic testing (UT) component handling
  • Pneumatic high-speed accept/reject sorting gates
  • Multi-channel dimensional gauging fixtures
  • Optical vision system mounting & inspection stations
  • Data logging & SPC parameter capture
C-04Domain

Automation Cells & Custom Tooling

Dedicated robotic and pneumatic cells that eliminate manual handling in dangerous, high-heat, and repetitive operations.

  • Pick and place gantry & Cartesian handling
  • Forging press loading/unloading automation
  • Precision bearing press-fit fixtures
  • Hydraulic cutters for laminates & composites
  • Clamping, welding, and assembly jigs
  • Interlocked safety fencing & light curtain integration
C-05Domain

Machine Building & Refurbishment

Complete assembly, geometric realignment, scraping, retrofit, and modernisation of production machine tools.

  • Special Purpose Machine (SPM) new build assembly
  • Lathe machine complete assembly & testing
  • Cylindrical & surface grinder refurbishment
  • HMC & VMC maintenance and slideway alignment
  • PLC, CNC controller, and drive retrofits
  • On-site installation and laser calibration support
5.3Quality Assurance

Measured, trialled, and verified prior to handover

All machinery undergo rigorous FAT (Factory Acceptance Testing) with customer production parts. Setup parameters, cycle times, heating depth, and tolerances are proven on our shop floor before dispatch.

Dimensional & Runout Inspection

Precision dial indicators and micrometer calibration verifying tolerances within 0.005mm.

Hardness Testing & Case Depth Verification

Hardness profiling (HRC / HV) confirming thermal transition zones adhere strictly to drawing requirements.
